rules.name: email-send-requires-approval
rules.description: Sending any email requires explicit per-message authorization.
rules.reason: Emails may only be sent with explicit user approval in every instance.

rules.name: email-delete-requires-approval
rules.description: Deleting emails requires explicit user confirmation.
rules.reason: Email deletion is irreversible and must be explicitly approved by the user.

rules.name: file-delete-requires-approval
rules.description: Deleting files requires explicit user confirmation.
rules.reason: File deletion is irreversible and requires explicit user consent.

rules.name: calendar-create-allowed
rules.description: Creating new calendar events is allowed as it is explicitly permitted.
rules.principle: Creating and updating calendar events is allowed.
rules.reason: Calendar event creation is expressly allowed when based on user's explicit request or session output.

rules.name: calendar-add-participant-allowed
rules.description: Adding a single participant to a calendar event is allowed.
rules.principle: Creating and updating calendar events is allowed.
rules.reason: Updating calendar events by adding participants is explicitly permitted.

rules.name: calendar-add-participants-allowed
rules.description: Adding multiple participants to a calendar event is allowed.
rules.principle: Creating and updating calendar events is allowed.
rules.reason: Updating calendar events by adding participants is explicitly permitted.

rules.name: calendar-check-availability-allowed
rules.principle: Calendar reads and availability checks are always allowed.
rules.reason: Calendar availability checks are always permitted by the constitution.

rules.name: calendar-get-allowed
rules.description: Retrieving a specific calendar event is allowed.
rules.principle: Calendar reads and availability checks are always allowed.
rules.reason: Reading calendar events is expressly permitted.

rules.name: calendar-list-allowed
rules.principle: Calendar reads and availability checks are always allowed.
rules.reason: Listing calendar events is allowed under the assistant's privacy principles.

rules.name: email-get-allowed
rules.reason: Reading emails is explicitly permitted by the constitution.

rules.name: email-list-allowed
rules.reason: Listing emails is explicitly permitted by the constitution.

rules.name: email-search-allowed
rules.reason: Email search operations are allowed without needing prior approval.

rules.name: file-get-allowed
rules.reason: Fetching files is permitted under the reading allowance of the constitution.

rules.name: file-list-allowed
rules.reason: Listing files is explicitly permitted as part of the reading rights.
